1479-2841-3897-8337.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

147-3899-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-3899-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

687-2138-4050-4613-8130.description:
Cast Lazotep Reaver by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Lazotep Reaver enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Lazotep Reaver and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Lazotep Reaver from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2138-4050-4613-8130.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

1479-2841-4862-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-4862-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

997-1263-4871-6248.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2946-3220-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3220-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2557-5086-5183-5231-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-5086-5183-5231-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

2921-5003-7283-7649.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-5003-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

224-277-2157-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Mutavault land token.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1018-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2228-3108-3388.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Moritte of the Frost.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2866-3375-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-3499-5686.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3499-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1445-5477-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5477-6633.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

673-813-2104.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Planar Incision.
673-813-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

372-4823-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Timeless Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-4823-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1018-2061-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
1018-2061-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

277-2203-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-2203-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

215-1308-4231-5444.description:
Cast Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{B/R}{B/R}.
When Carnage Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight Clue, Food and Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B/R}{B/R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Carnage Interpreter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

2136-2178-5073.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
2136-2178-5073.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Tinder Wall with haste.
Activate the five Tinder Wall tokens' first abilities by sacrificing them, adding ten {R}.
When the Tinder Wall tokens die, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Tinder Wall tokens and/or target any other creature.

737-2825-4067-5126.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an opponent to discard a card.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control at least one mana-producing permanent.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
737-2825-4067-5126.description:
Cause an opponent to discard at least one card.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding Entropic Eidolon and another card, untapping Elite Arcanist and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream Salvage without paying its mana cost.
Entropic Eidolon triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve Dream Salvage, causing you to draw at least one card.
Repeat from step 2.

1117-1822-3689-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact with mana value one or less that can be cast using only colorless mana.
1117-1822-3689-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value one or less and Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, its ability triggers twice, returning Junk Diver and the nontoken artifact with mana one or less to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Junk Diver and the nontoken artifact by paying at most {4}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact and Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers twice, returning the nontoken artifact and Workshop Assistant to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast the nontoken artifact and Workshop Assistant by paying at most {4}.
Repeat.

1737-1912-2119-2544.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Seat of the Synod.
Activate the Seat of the Synod token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

3003-3139-4432.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six artifacts.
3003-3139-4432.description:
Cast Leashling by paying {0}.
Leashling enters the battlefield, triggering The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Leashling by putting a card from your hand on top of your library, returning Leashling to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-2354-2530.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2354-2530.description:
Activate Krav by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Krav.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Carnival of Souls, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Repeat.

573-1530-3293.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
573-1530-3293.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Play Gruul Turf from your hand.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Emeria Shepherd.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
